security_justification.audit_integrity: No audit event, contract, checksum or governance assertion changes; preventing fixture housekeeping races keeps required checks focused on the gates they test.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication, authorization, principal or permission decision changes; the two settings govern only Git housekeeping in synthetic fixture repositories.
security_justification.authority_provenance: No authority source, provenance claim, owner decision or signed evidence changes; files bound by the active normative-precedence signed record remain untouched.
security_justification.concurrency: The correction prevents a detached Git maintenance writer in temporary fixtures but introduces no scheduler, lock, shared state or concurrent coordination mechanism.
security_justification.confidentiality: No secrets, credentials or confidential payloads are processed; command-line configuration concerns only local disposable fixture Git state.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic algorithm, key, signing or verification behavior changes; existing identity and commit.gpgsign=false entries remain byte-identical.
security_justification.error_disclosure: No error reporting or diagnostic surface changes; existing Git invocation and recursive removal errors remain observable without new data disclosure.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No external security product, service, network request, exporter or deployment is introduced; the correction is confined to local test fixtures.
security_justification.fail_posture: The known housekeeping writer is prevented before it starts; existing gate assertions and loud one-shot removal failures are neither weakened nor retried away.
security_justification.lifecycle: No runtime, release or governance lifecycle transition changes; only Git commands during an existing disposable fixture lifetime gain maintenance settings.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: No persistent Git configuration is written; exact helper ownership bounds the flag changes and signed-change-bound files, individual tests and live repository mutation behavior stay unchanged.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No personal data, telemetry, redaction, classification or privacy transformation changes; these fixtures use synthetic repository inputs only.
security_justification.resource_retention: No retention policy or cleanup ownership changes; existing disposal still removes the temporary repository once, without a detached housekeeping writer racing it.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No retry, delivery, redelivery, queue or attempt logic changes; the existing helper methods and removal behavior remain unchanged.
security_justification.trust_boundary: The existing local fixture and live repository boundaries remain unchanged; no principal, trust crossing or new external system is added.
